mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, s.SUB_CATE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, p.PROD_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, o.ORDER_CNT, o.ORDER_STATUS, o.SHIP_STATUS, o.REFUND_STATUS, o.REFUND_CONTENT FROM ORDERS o JOIN USERS u ON o.USER_ID = u.USER_ID JOIN PRODUCTS p ON o.PROD_CODE = p.PROD_CODE JOIN SUB_CATEGORY s ON p.SUB_CATE_CODE = s.SUB_CATE_CODE
